parts.name: casting

physics.Basic_description: The main black body of the plane, appearing as a heavy cast metal structure with a matte finish.
physics.Functional_description: Provides the structural backbone and mass for the tool, holding all other components in alignment.
physics.Grasped_description: Grasp the central body firmly from the sides or top to support the tool's weight during manipulation.
physics.reason: Cast iron plane bodies are ribbed shells with internal voids to save weight while maintaining rigidity, not solid blocks.

parts.description: The main black body of the plane, appearing as a heavy cast metal structure with a matte finish.
parts.function: Provides the structural backbone and mass for the tool, holding all other components in alignment.

parts.name: sole edge

physics.Basic_description: The flat bottom surface of the plane, machined smooth and metallic grey.
physics.Functional_description: Slides along the workpiece surface to ensure a flat cut.
physics.Grasped_description: Not intended for grasping; it is the functional contact surface with the wood.
physics.reason: The sole is a thick, machined face of the casting, effectively solid material at the contact interface.

parts.description: The flat bottom surface of the plane, machined smooth and metallic grey.
parts.function: Slides along the workpiece surface to ensure a flat cut.

parts.name: frog

physics.Basic_description: An angled black metal platform mounted on the body, supporting the blade assembly.
physics.Functional_description: Holds the cutting iron at the correct angle (usually 45 degrees) relative to the sole.
physics.Grasped_description: Too small and recessed to be a primary grasp point; usually adjusted via screws.
physics.reason: Small cast component, likely solid or thick-walled enough to approximate as solid for physics.

parts.description: An angled black metal platform mounted on the body, supporting the blade assembly.
parts.function: Holds the cutting iron at the correct angle (usually 45 degrees) relative to the sole.

parts.name: palm heel boss

physics.Basic_description: A gold-colored metallic protrusion at the rear of the plane body.
physics.Functional_description: Provides a hard surface for the palm to push against during planing strokes.
physics.Grasped_description: Could be touched by a gripper but not a secure grasp point due to shape.
physics.reason: Small brass insert or boss, typically solid metal.

parts.description: A gold-colored metallic protrusion at the rear of the plane body.
parts.function: Provides a hard surface for the palm to push against during planing strokes.

parts.name: depth stud

physics.Basic_description: A small brass threaded post or knob near the adjustment mechanism.
physics.Functional_description: Part of the depth adjustment mechanism, engaging with the wheel or lever.
physics.Grasped_description: Too small to grasp reliably; manipulated by rotating adjacent parts.
physics.reason: Small machined brass component, solid.

parts.description: A small brass threaded post or knob near the adjustment mechanism.
parts.function: Part of the depth adjustment mechanism, engaging with the wheel or lever.

parts.name: cap screw

physics.Basic_description: A dark metallic screw head securing the lever cap.
physics.Functional_description: Clamps the lever cap down onto the cutting iron to hold it in place.
physics.Grasped_description: Requires a tool (screwdriver) to manipulate, not a gripper grasp.
physics.reason: Standard machine screw, solid steel.

parts.description: A dark metallic screw head securing the lever cap.
parts.function: Clamps the lever cap down onto the cutting iron to hold it in place.

parts.name: iron

physics.Basic_description: A silver, flat steel blade with a sharpened edge, angled upwards.
physics.Functional_description: The actual cutting tool that removes shavings from the wood surface.
physics.Grasped_description: Can be grasped by the top edge for removal or adjustment, though sharp.
physics.reason: Flat plate of tool steel, solid throughout.

parts.description: A silver, flat steel blade with a sharpened edge, angled upwards.
parts.function: The actual cutting tool that removes shavings from the wood surface.

parts.name: cap

physics.Basic_description: A shiny silver metal cover that sits over the blade and frog.
physics.Functional_description: Applies pressure to the cutting iron to prevent chatter and holds the chip breaker.
physics.Grasped_description: Grasp the top surface or edges to lift or adjust the cap assembly.
physics.reason: Cast or stamped metal cover, thin-walled shell structure.

parts.description: A shiny silver metal cover that sits over the blade and frog.
parts.function: Applies pressure to the cutting iron to prevent chatter and holds the chip breaker.

parts.name: hump

physics.Basic_description: A smooth, light brown wooden knob or hump at the rear of the plane.
physics.Functional_description: Ergonomic handle for the user's palm to apply downward and forward pressure.
physics.Grasped_description: Primary grasp point for the rear hand; wrap fingers around or press palm on top.
physics.reason: Turned wood handle, solid material.

parts.description: A smooth, light brown wooden knob or hump at the rear of the plane.
parts.function: Ergonomic handle for the user's palm to apply downward and forward pressure.

parts.name: lever

physics.Basic_description: A thin silver metal lever extending upwards near the blade.
physics.Functional_description: Adjusts the lateral tilt of the cutting iron to ensure a level cut.
physics.Grasped_description: Too thin and delicate for a power grasp; nudged with a finger or gripper tip.
physics.reason: Thin steel rod/lever, solid cross-section.

parts.description: A thin silver metal lever extending upwards near the blade.
parts.function: Adjusts the lateral tilt of the cutting iron to ensure a level cut.

parts.name: wheel

physics.Basic_description: A small, knurled brass wheel located at the rear of the frog area.
physics.Functional_description: Rotated to raise or lower the cutting iron for depth of cut adjustment.
physics.Grasped_description: Pinch the wheel between gripper fingers to rotate it for adjustment.
physics.reason: Small machined brass wheel, solid.

parts.description: A small, knurled brass wheel located at the rear of the frog area.
parts.function: Rotated to raise or lower the cutting iron for depth of cut adjustment.

simulation.collision: CoACD convex decomposition of concave source collision meshes (relative tolerance 0.03–0.05)
simulation.inertia: Source URDF link inertials; missing inertials use geometry-derived defaults (density 1000 kg/m³)
simulation.friction: Source URDF mu1 as sliding friction; torsional 0.005, rolling 0.0001
simulation.contact: MuJoCo soft contacts (solref 0.01 1); source restitution is displayed, not converted
simulation.material: Rigid bodies; Young’s modulus and Poisson ratio are annotations, not soft-body parameters

interaction.description: Switchable virtual joint damping and reflected armature for interactive inspection; source properties are unchanged.
interaction.rule: damping ≥ rated effort / rated speed; armature = 2% child subtree mass (slide) or 2% mass × collision radius² (hinge)

collisionFilter.description: Self-contact excluded between directly connected rigid groups, including the fixed base; nonadjacent contacts retained
